question: Should OpenClaw permanently support bundled Discord source-message subagent progress with seven configuration fields and a core channel lifecycle completion adapter?
rationale: Technical repair cannot decide whether this user-facing configuration, shared requester metadata, lifecycle adapter, and persisted marker should become permanent supported contracts.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Approve the direction after both lifecycle defects are fixed and exact merged-head Discord proof is posted.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Keep the visible idea but redesign it around fewer controls and a smaller generic lifecycle contract.

options.title: Do not sponsor
options.body: Decline the bundled feature and avoid adding the new compatibility surfaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Approve the direction after both lifecycle defects are fixed and exact merged-head Discord proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Discord channel ownership makes this the strongest available owner for the bundled feature and configuration decision.
